backup.production_rule: s108 (Lloyd: any staff user can add, edit or delete product options under a stock item, admins approve). New table public.inventory_option_requests (RLS on, no grants to any client role, not in realtime), four security definer RPCs for authenticated (inventory_option_request_v1 create/apply, inventory_option_requests_v1 list, inventory_option_request_decide_v1, inventory_option_request_cancel_v1) and three internal functions with no grants. Nothing existing is changed. Run only on a restore point younger than one hour, after the s106 and s107 releases are applied.
backup.notes: Additive. Applying changes no existing row. The only writes to existing tables happen later, through the RPCs: options added/edited/deleted by approved requests, and follow_up_tasks rows (source_kind option_request) opened for pending requests.
